title: Veritas Acta Receipt v2
description: Ed25519-signed, JCS-canonicalized decision receipt for machine access control. Produced by @scopeblind/protect-mcp and verifiable with @veritasacta/verify.

payload.description: The canonical payload (JCS-ordered) that was signed.

v.description: Schema version. v2 adds tier, credential_ref, policy_engine.

tool.description: Name of the MCP tool that was called (e.g., 'read_file', 'deploy').

decision.description: The access decision made by the gateway.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonicalized policy file. 'none' if no policy loaded.

policy_engine.description: Which policy engine made the decision (v2).

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this request (12-char UUID prefix).

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the decision was made.

mode.description: Operating mode of the gateway at decision time.

rate_limit_remaining.description: Remaining rate limit budget after this request (if rate limit is configured).

tier.description: Trust tier of the agent at decision time (v2).

credential_ref.description: Credential label used for this request. Never the actual secret value.

kid.description: Key identifier of the signing key.

sig.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature over the JCS-canonicalized payload.

pub.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 public key (optional, for self-contained verification).

meta.description: Optional metadata not covered by the signature.

issuer.description: Identifier of the gateway that issued this receipt.
